name: Haloo Trademark Clearance
description:
Connect to Haloo for trademark clearance workflows directly in Claude.

Haloo performs a deep, full clearance search, not a knockout. Built on examiner methodology and trained on real-world trademark outcomes, it scans hundreds of millions of records across live global trademark registries using 62 retrieval algorithms that identify identical, phonetic, visual, conceptual, and related conflicts. Results are ranked by likelihood of confusion with legal rationale for each. Every search generates a ranked retrieval set with conflict scores and an editable clearance memorandum with a stoplight risk assessment, key citations, and jurisdiction-specific legal analysis.

Ask Claude to run a clearance search for a new brand name, suggest alternative name options if conflicts are found, or draft a trademark application with the best filing strategy given the results.

Each search covers one mark in one jurisdiction. Global clearance runs as separate jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction searches. Each search is $150 USD.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Haloo Trademark Clearance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Haloo Trademark Clearance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.haloo.ai/trademark-search/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Haloo Trademark Clearance MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Haloo Trademark Clearance provides these MCP tools: get_clearance_report and search_trademark.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Haloo Trademark Clearance?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Haloo Trademark Clearance in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Haloo Trademark Clearance MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Haloo Trademark Clearance requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Haloo Trademark Clearance is developed by Haloo Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
